facts.fact: Tilde 最后一次走出家门，母亲没有哭，走进的是傍晚被拉长的金光
facts.anchor: My mother did not weep as I stepped out of our home for the last time

facts.fact: 母亲 Rivani 按 Merogian 庆典样式散着深色卷发，神气却是哀悼；宫中有人哭，老厨娘的抽泣被听见
facts.anchor: King Rivani wore her dark curls loose in the style of Merogian celebration, but her expression was one of mourning

facts.fact: 护卫只能带五名、由国王使节从母亲旧部里挑，她仍要留下 Marolyn 这把忠心的刀，并给她和自己一样好的衣裳
facts.anchor: I knew I would need a loyal knife at my back

facts.fact: 她没把复仇计划告诉 Hadiah，也没能劝她回去，只盼动手那天她的清白与贵族血统能保她
facts.anchor: her innocence and noble blood would save her

facts.fact: 风掀开太阳，光照亮上墙：本族的蛇旗仍悬在天鹅旗之下
facts.anchor: the snake flag of our clan and our kingdom still hung beneath the banner of the swan

facts.fact: 母亲自 kingsmoot 后再未唱过；这是 kithwood 的古调、用本族古语唱，被暴君与 Synod 禁绝，父母只敢深夜低声哼给孩子听
facts.anchor: She had not sung since the kingsmoot

facts.fact: 母亲站着、双手前伸、声音高扬；祭司 Cnul 在身后低头肃立，不敢出面阻止，人群随后接唱她的歌
facts.anchor: Priest Cnul stood behind her, his head bowed and grave, but he did not dare try to stop it
